purpose: Teach: 心底/まんが/諸々/愛想/すばやく/はまり/ゆで/まだしも

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは心底家族を大事にされた
lines.en: Gran — when Dad was young, he treasured family more than anything.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Measured pace. Reaching back into memory with tenderness. Slight pause before the key word. Voice settling into warmth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、まんがをお孫様に買ってこられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — Grandpa, he used to bring manga home for the grandchildren, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright recognition. Warm, affectionate address. A small smile in the voice. Gentle correction-by-remembering. Trailing 'dear' that's intimate, not distant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは諸々のお祭り行事を仕切られた
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, Dad took charge of all the festival preparations.
lines.style: Same reflective tone as before. Eyes still on the past. Steady, even pacing. Voice carries quiet pride in the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご近所に愛想よくされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — he was so friendly with the neighbors, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation. Light, affirming energy. The word 'friendly' carries real warmth. A slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはすばやく決断された
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, Dad made decisions quickly and with conviction.
lines.style: The same reflective current runs through. A note of admiration underneath. Unhurried delivery. The word 'quickly' doesn't rush — it's stated with respect.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、骨董集めにはまりこんでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — he became quite absorbed in collecting antiques, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing. A hint of affectionate teasing. Slight emphasis on 'absorbed.' Voice has the comfort of shared knowledge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがゆで小豆を作って下さった
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, Dad made red bean paste for us.
lines.style: Tender shift. The simplicity of the memory softens the voice. Slower pace. The detail feels precious. Almost whispered at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦争ならまだしも、家族の事は耐えられないと仰った
lines.en: Grandpa — he said he could bear the war, but not losing family.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. The voice drops slightly. A long, steady breath before 'losing.' The final word carries the weight of everything unsaid. Very gentle close.
